newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Central Puerto details non consolidated earnings.
newsitem.headline: Central Puerto details non consolidated earnings.

text.p: Argentine thermoelectric generator Central Puerto said Tuesday that the non consolidated EPS and non consolidated earnings per ADR it reported Monday are the same as the consolidated ones.
The company had reported non consolidated EPS of $0.09 vs $0.07 and non consolidated earnings per ADR of $0.45 vs $0.34.

A 31 percent stake of Central Puerto, Argentina's largest thermoelectric generator, is in the hands of Chile's Chilgener SA, which is its operator. Another 31 percent is held by Chile's Chilquinta and Pacifico Quinta Region, while the rest is floating.
